notes.title: Closed Backer Preview 0.3
notes.content:
[u][b]New Content[/b][/u]

[b]First Blob World[/b]
Pirate Blob World - Still very rudimentary with no special rooms, items and secrets locked for final game.
Performance also not optimised like for most of the other game, so it might run slow on some PCs.

HowTo: Talk to Pearl in front of Ruin to continue the adventurers club quest.


[b]Breeding[/b]
Basic breeding, mainly to experiment for look
Stats, Special Food, Mutations and other secrets locked for full game release

Howto:
Feed a Heart Fruit (purchase form Flint) to 2 blob in your barn to get them in the "mating" mod indicated by a heart emote. 
With enough happiness they will get into "breeding" mode (indicated by an egg emote).
After 3 days an egg id produced. The stats of the breeded are better/or worse depending hwo well you cared for their parents during breeding.

[b]Blob Adoption[/b]
You can now give up blobs for adotption if you don't need them. The option is available in your blob barn UI (blue book).

[b]New Crops:[/b] Banana, Pineapple, Melon
[b]New Tree:[/b] Palm Tree
[b]New Items:[/b] Worm, Blob Island Cocktail, Pirate Rune
[b]New Blueprint:[/b] Fishing Cage, Magical Storage (buy from Carnelian)
[b]New Blob Abilities:[/b] Explosion, Sprinkler, Light Bait
[b]Item Update:[/b] Oysters cure blindness, (Matched health/energy heal + price)

[b]General Improvements[/b]
- Storages: Item details are now displayed in the magical storage and shipment box
- Storages: Fast switch between containers with L2/R2 when playing with controller
- Trees: Planted trees can be now moved and rotated in the build mode (workbench)
- Bosses: Big lotus blob doesn't disappear until next season when the battle is lost, bosses now can revive minions
- Sped up pet blobs animation to reduce petting duration

notes.title: CBP 0.21
notes.content:
[b]Balancing:[/b]

- increased day length from 12 min to 16 min
  (before 0.75 real life seconds = 1 ingame minute now: 1 real life second = 1 in-game minute)

- decreased base energy cost for tool from 5 to 4.
  (effects shovel, axe, pickaxe, hoe, watering can, bug net, fishing rod

- removed energy cost for harvesting crops and shaking trees (was 5 before, now 0)

- decreased required friendship points from 25 to 20 for one level

- reduced strength of stat changing battle skills (Shield, Sharpen, Haste, Hacking, Wood Shield) 

[b]Bug fixing:[/b]

- fixed unlimited stones when mining huge rocks

- fixed accidently setting german language which is not fully translated yet
